row.proto: void Career_Cancel_UpgradeResearch(void *upgrades, uint32_t owner, void *inst, uint32_t day)
row.notes: U-level research cancel (Upgrades, owner, instance, day): 0x143523cc0 restores the state before InProgress and clears fitted, mode 2 mirrors it on the sibling tree, then availability refresh / owner cache reset. No RP: the component cancel 0x141241770 refunds before calling it.

verify.notes: V0241 0x143523cc0 acts only when the latest state is InProgress/InDevelopment (or entry+9==3) and the owner matches; it clears +0x7e..+0x94, pushes the most recent earlier state that is neither InProgress nor InDevelopment (Invalid if none) and clears fitted; mode 2 mirrors onto the same-id instances of the other owners still InProgress; 0x141241770 refunds cost(+0x90)*upgrades+0x6c/100 RP first; also posts the upgrades-changed message
